page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Full-width text in centred lines from top to bottom, with a woodcut ornament of two putti and a wreath between the text blocks. No margin notes. Pencilled manuscript number "16" at top right and a library shelf mark at lower right are not printed and are left out.

main_text.l: V.D.M. Linguæ Sanctæ & Ethices in Gymnasio
Bern. Professore Ordinario, Mæcenate ac Fautore suo
Publicè pro viribus defendendam in se suscipit
Ad diem Maji horis locoq; solitis.
Ad numerandum dies nostros, sic facias cognoscere;
ut accipiamus cor sapientiæ. Psalm. 90. v. 12.
Ex Officina Typogr. ILLUSTRISS. REIP. BERNENSIS.
Per Andream Hügenetum, M DC LXXXIV.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament between "Ad diem" and "Ad numerandum" is an engraved putti-and-wreath device, not text. The printed date reads MDCLXXXIV in the scan; "Ad diem" line uses a long-s-free reading as printed. Doubtful: "locoq;" is read as printed, and the word "Ad" before "diem" is in script-like type. Some words in the printed title are partly obscured by a diagonal pencil stroke near "VULPIUS" and "RODOLPHO", which do not prevent reading.
